source_row.acip: 'DI LA KUN SLONG BYE BRAG CAN DPER NA, LHAS BYIN KHO NA BSAD SNYAM NAS SBYOR BA BRTZAMS PA NA MCHOD SBYIN DU NOR NAS BSAD NA, DNGOS GZHI'I SDIG MED PAS DE LTA BU LA 'DU SHES MA 'KHRUL BA DGOS SHING , SBYOR BA'I DUS SU GANG BYUNG YANG GSOD SNYAM PA KUN SLONG SPYI LA ZHUGS PA YOD NA 'DU SHES MA 'KHRUL BA MI DGOS SO, , TSUL 'DI NI LHAG MA DGU LA YANG CI RIGS PAR SHES PAR BYA'O, ,
source_row.wylie: 'di la kun slong bye brag can dper na, lhas byin kho na bsad snyam nas sbyor ba brtsams pa na mchod sbyin du nor nas bsad na, dngos gzhi'i sdig med pas de lta bu la 'du shes ma 'khrul ba dgos shing , sbyor ba'i dus su gang byung yang gsod snyam pa kun slong spyi la zhugs pa yod na 'du shes ma 'khrul ba mi dgos so, , tshul 'di ni lhag ma dgu la yang ci rigs par shes par bya'o,
source_row.english: This is a particular feature of the motivation. Suppose, for example, that you think to yourself, "I only want to kill John," and undertake the deed. Then you mistake Joe for John, and kill Joe. In this sort of case, there is no "actual- commission" stage; so we can see that, for this stage, the conception you have must be unmistaken. If on the other hand you undertake the deed with some general kind of motivation, if you think to yourself, "I'll kill anyone I happen to meet," then this detail of the conception having to be unmistaken need not be complete. You should understand that this point applies to the other nine as well.

spans.rationale: The opening demonstrative resumes the conception rule and owns This, without absorbing the supplied copula.
The first motivation noun is the specific intention whose feature is explained.
The entire expression directly attests particular feature. CAN is retained as part of that expression, not made a separate English word.
The full example-introducing expression supplies for example. Suppose is additional English conditional framing.

The hypothetical intended victim is named LHAS BYIN in Tibetan and John in this exact GMR example. This is a contextual name substitution, not a claim that the glossary Devadatta literally says John. It owns only the first John in the stated intention.
The complete restrictive expression supplies only in the intended-victim quotation; want to remains outside the killing verb.
First BSAD is the contemplated killing of the intended John target.
The thought-quotation verb supplies first think. Full glossary also attests think to yourself, but the tight verb leaves English subject/reflexive framing outside.
The first undertaking term has explicit undertake evidence and is recast as this verb. BRTSAMS PA marks beginning the action and is not independently assigned the supplied deed.

The mistakenly killed other person is MCHOD SBYIN, rendered Joe here. The master auto-mined John candidate is contradicted by the roles in this exact example and is not promoted. Own only the first Joe after mistake; later Joe is an English repetition.
NOR uses the mistake sense, not its unrelated wealth sense. The compared John is an English resumption of the earlier target.
Second BSAD is the actual killing of the mistaken Joe target, distinct from the intended killing and later anyone quotation.

The established technical stage name has exact glossary actual- commission evidence. Preserve the physical line-break-derived space after the hyphen; stage remains explanatory wording outside the head.
The complete demonstrative-comparison plus case construction owns this case frame. DE LTA BU already attests the full phrase; LA remains intact within the grammatical phrase.
First conception noun here concerns the specifically intended target, not the later general motivation case.
The complete established adjective supplies the required unmistaken recognition for the specific-target case.
The lexical necessity verb explicitly supports must. The supplied be and you-have framing remain outside.
Second undertaking occurrence belongs to the general-motivation condition, not the first particular-target example.
The complete indefinite directly attests anyone. I happen to meet elaborates the contingency; do not split BYUNG into an additional event word from this established indefinite.
The last killing verb belongs to the unrestricted anyone thought, distinct from the two BSAD occurrences.
The complete second thought form owns second think. Supplied second-person and reflexive wording remains outside.
Second motivation noun belongs to the unrestricted intention.
The general/universal adjective distinguishes this motivation from the particular feature in the first example. Kind of is supplied English support.
The final conditional particle after YOD opens the general-motivation condition recast first in English. Other hand is connective framing, not another source noun.
Second conception noun is the condition whose unmistaken status need not be required in the general case.
Second complete adjective owns second unmistaken. It is embedded under lack of necessity, not an assertion that the conception is mistaken.
The whole negative-necessity construction directly supports need not. The broader detail/having-to-be/complete framing is not split into nonexistent source completion words.

spans.nul: Complete SO closes the general-motivation statement at the period after complete. The full particle entry supports statement-end punctuation fusion. It does not supply the lexical complete or null any uncertain necessity wording.

The final demonstrative points back to the method just explained; it owns this before point.
The remaining/other adjective refers to the nine other deeds beyond killing.
The cardinal supplies nine, without inventing an unprinted deeds noun.
The additive applies the point to those nine also, rendered the complete as well phrase.

The complete obligatory-knowing construction supports should understand and retains its final bound ending. The supplied English You is excluded. No CI RIGS PAR mined complete you should understand gloss is promoted.

omissions.tib: initial la; first two nas/na sequences; brtsams pa; du after mchod sbyin; bound genitives; sdig med pas; shing
omissions.reason: The first example is expanded into Suppose/Then/and and a stage-based conclusion. BRTSAMS PA beginning is incorporated in undertaking without a separate start word. The source denies the wrong deed of actual commission; English recasts this as no actual-commission stage. SDIG and the causal negative MED PAS have distributed scope across the stage denial and so-we-can-see inference; leave these uncertain units unbanked rather than assigning SDIG to stage or splitting PAS.

omissions.tib: sbyor ba'i dus su; yang after gang byung; la zhugs pa yod; final tshul ni la ci rigs par
omissions.reason: Temporal/event, unrestricted scope and existence of the general motivation are recast across the English conditional. The final point/applicability statement paraphrases TSHUL and CI RIGS PAR without a securely exclusive narrow atom. CI RIGS PAR has a mined complete you should understand string, which crosses the clause boundary and is not used. These uncertainties remain omitted, never null.
